semantic_scope: Exhaustive forward relation edges between original HCG statement/declaration endpoints and projected environment nodes; no REV relations or transitive closure.

State declarations retain visibility/storage qualifiers. These strings are source identity selectors, not parser output.
coverage: L3 parameter now shadows environment alias
notes: No claim of compiler acceptance; this fixture tests explicit binding policy on source syntax.
